blocks.title:
How we work.
The same way, every account.
blocks.sub: Scope before money. Senior only. Measured before we claim it improved. Easy to leave. Not values on a wall: clauses in the SOW, and habits you can check in the first fortnight.

blocks.title: How we staff an account.
rows: Everyone we put on your account has shipped to production for years, not months. There is no junior tier, so there is nobody to hide behind one.
We staff for your engagement, not ahead of it. You meet the engineer before they start, and you can say no.
If it is not working inside the first month, a replacement is in your standup within ten working days.

blocks.title: Our SDLC runs on Claude Code. A person signs every increment.
blocks.sub: We built the pipeline for a ten-engineer practice, where it is now the default path for new work. It is how every Hopsig build runs: the agents do the planning, the tests and the paperwork; the people do the judgement. Two Android apps scoped at five developers shipped with one, on the original timeline.
rows: The build is planned with a solutions-architect agent before anyone writes code. The plan is a document you can read and object to.
Epics and stories are populated and tracked automatically, in your Jira or ours, so progress is visible without a status meeting.
Stories are implemented autonomously inside guardrails: your conventions, your boundaries, enforced on every change.
Automated review and generated tests run before a senior looks. A senior always looks.
Documentation is written as the code changes, so it is never a week behind and never a handover task.
When a decision needs a person, it is pushed to a phone with the context, and the pipeline waits.

blocks.title: Where we are, when we are.
rows: Four hours is enough for a standup, a review and a pairing session, and it is the same four hours every day, so nobody is doing it at midnight. For US teams we shift the day: [OVERLAP WITH ET] hours with Eastern time.
We are in Lahore, Pakistan. Delivery happens here, and the people who scope your work are the people who do it. Company details: [COMPANY REG NO.], established [YEAR].

blocks.title: The people who scope your work are the people who do it.
blocks.sub: Bring the problem, not a brief. If it is outside what we do well, we will say which of our contacts to call instead.
blocks.emailLine: Or email [HELLO@HOPSIG.COM] — reply within one working day.
